office_integration_details: The Office command center reads runtime/execution_dispatch/current.json when present, exposes dispatch queued/ready/running/blocked/attention counts in the status payload and status bar, and adds a dispatch activity-console summary. The Operator Activity Stream also treats runtime/execution_dispatch/current.json as a local source. No new Office was created and the Office remains a consumer, not the dispatch authority.

provider_handoff_behavior.codex_bridge_handoff: prepare-handoff writes a Codex Bridge request-shaped JSON file under runtime/execution_dispatch/handoffs/ for codex-cli-openai or codex-cli-ollama items.
provider_handoff_behavior.safety: The handoff sets dry_run true, records handoff_mode dry_run_only_no_live_provider_invocation, and does not call Codex Bridge execution or any external provider.
